title: ModelerBOM
description: Bill of materials / device count of a Portunix Modeler model (ptx-modeler bom -f json, portunix-plugins #120). Devices are counted with their multiplicity ('count', e.g. '(2x)') and grouped by symbol, room or circuit; devices with a different variant (e.g. dimming modifier) form separate items. Groups and items are in a deterministic order, so the output is byte-identical across runs. Files use the '.bom.json' filename suffix.

model.description: Model name (meta 'name' of the model document)

total.description: Number of devices in the model, multiplicity included

groups.description: Groups in natural order of 'group'; the 'unassigned' group (devices without a room or circuit) comes last

group.description: Symbol key, room number or circuit designation; 'unassigned' for devices without a room or circuit

name.description: Room name, or circuit type for circuits

count.description: Number of devices in the group, multiplicity included

items.description: Items ordered by symbol key, then variant (no variant first)

name_cs.description: Czech symbol name from the catalog

name_en.description: English symbol name from the catalog
